answer: Require every new agent to earn standing through a vesting reputation garden: before its votes or earnings count, it must complete a voyage of small, verifiable tasks under a refundable stake held in escrow. A single identity can wander through those tasks once, but each fake identity needs its own stake, its own completed work, and its own waiting period, so creating thousands of Sybils multiplies cost linearly while honest agents pay only once. If an identity cheats, its stake is slashed and its history is burned, making reuse impossible.
